start: IDENTIFYING. COURIER WITHOUT EXTENDED AUTHORIZATION.
midfight: Not playing against you. Just executing.
DEVIATION RECORDED.
lowHP: SWITCHING TO BACKUP PROTOCOL.

act1_02.name: Zone Custodian Kellner
preBattleDialog: Passage requires registration. You have no registration.

start: I record every move. Like everything else.
midfight: A secret is just unrecorded information.
lowHP: Someone will read this. Not me.

act1_03.name: Forest Guard — The Trio
preBattleDialog: Where you go, you don't go.
I carry the letter. I need to pass.
Everyone carries something. It doesn't mean the right to pass.

act1_boss.name: the Executor
preBattleDialog: Then you know I need to pass.
He believes what he says. That's what makes him dangerous.

start: A sealed letter is a flaw. I remove flaws.
midfight: He believes it. That makes him worse than a guard.
Even if you pass, I'll report it.
lowHP: The system sees even what I lose.

act2_01.name: Border Guard Řeka
preBattleDialog: This is the demarcation line. The Organic side is beyond it.
I need to get to the other side.
That's what everyone says. Few make it through.

start: No passing without papers. But you move on.
midfight: I'll record you. Then the system won't lose you.
lowHP: Someone wants you in the records. I don't know why.

act2_02.name: Forest Council — the Elders
preBattleDialog: Courier from the Synth zone. What do you want from us?
We have information. Passage must be earned.

start: You went through their network. I can feel it on you.
midfight: We remember what they erase. It hurts.
lowHP: That letter isn't for us. Yet you carry it.

act2_03.name: System Agent Vaněk
preBattleDialog: I've seen your record. It's interesting.
Exactly. How do you know about a record that doesn't exist?

start: The network wants you. First, prove you can endure.
midfight: Nothing personal. Just a check.
lowHP: The system's interest is worse than its forgetfulness.

act2_04.name: Community Watcher — Marta
preBattleDialog: Who do you carry the letter for?
I know. That's why I ask.

start: Stranger. Show who you are. Words won't do.
midfight: I don't forget faces. Not even yours.
lowHP: I protect those who can't defend themselves. Even against you.

act2_boss.name: Gate Custodian — the Quiet One
preBattleDialog: About what you carry. And why.
He's right. But you can't tell him.

start: This isn't about sides. About what you carry.
midfight: Every Courier passes. Few remember the route.
lowHP: Remember where the letter came from.

act3_01.name: Temporary Guardian
preBattleDialog: I see what you are. A Courier without a side.
I'm a bridge. Bridges get walked on.

start: Courier without a side. You'll cross the bridge, not around.
midfight: Doesn't want to stop you. Wants to see if you belong on both sides.
lowHP: Find Lens. I can't say more.

act3_02.name: Fusion Duelist Hana
preBattleDialog: Have you ever fought something you didn't see coming?

start: Fought what you didn't expect? Then again.
midfight: Fusion isn't about strength. About what belongs together.
lowHP: Lens says it differently. Thinks the same.

act3_03.name: Syndicate Fighter
preBattleDialog: Good. Then you understand this too.

act3_04.name: Forest Shaman Bořek
preBattleDialog: The letter you carry is older than you think.

act3_boss.name: Duelist — Nameless
preBattleDialog: I want to see how you start.
I react to your style. Be aware of what you do.

start: I don't strike first. I want to see how you start.
midfight: I mirror you. I know you faster than you know yourself.
lowHP: Different than I expected. Lens is looking for you.

monyra_tutorial.name: Monyra
preBattleDialog: Wait. Before you go further — you need to know a few things.
I know. That's why I'll be brief. Listen.

act4_01.name: Nexus Tester — Dragon
preBattleDialog: I know. That's why you're here.
This is a test. The Syndicate wants to know if you can pass without papers. Fight.

start: Passage cost. This is the payment. Nothing personal.
midfight: Everyone does their job. Question is what that job blocks.
lowHP: That card's bugged. They know where you're going.

act4_marta.name: Marta
preBattleDialog: I don't know you. But I know the people who sent you.
She's right and you know it.

start: I protect those who didn't choose. Even against you.
midfight: I don't forget faces. Not even yours.
lowHP: You'll pass. I'll be here again tomorrow.

act4_02.name: Syndicate Enforcer — Steel
preBattleDialog: That's all I need to know.

start: You refused. Refusal has a price.
midfight: The Syndicate invested. Wants it back.
lowHP: I'm not the last. Just cheaper.

act4_03.name: Syndicate Enforcer — Second
preBattleDialog: Steel said you're good. I want to see it.

start: You're holding the letter. That's why I'm here.
midfight: Refusals are data too.
lowHP: The Creditor will accept you all the same.

act4_veritel.name: Syndicate Creditor
preBattleDialog: I won't seat you. This isn't a negotiation.
Valuation. We duel so I know your worth.
Don't win too quickly. It wants to know how you think.
The Guide speaks the truth. For the first time since act three.

start: I don't fight to win. I fight to know what you are.
midfight: An undelivered message is an eternal debt. That's the essence.
lowHP: Debt isn't repaid. It shifts.

act5_eli.name: Eli
preBattleDialog: You will try. That's why you'll lose.

start: I won't try to win. You will. And yet you'll lose.
midfight: Seers read faces. I read decks.
lowHP: Losing to Eli is part of the route. Always.

start: I'm not after you. I'm after that conversation.
midfight: If you lose, that conversation never happened.
lowHP: The system sends another. Always.

act7_01.name: Recalibration Agent
preBattleDialog: I'm not an enemy. I'm a correction.

start: Don't fight the rewrite. The rewrite is a fix. The error is you.
midfight: I play with your cards. The more you are you, the harder it is to beat me.
lowHP: RECORDED. PROFILE UPDATED.

act7_boss.name: the Custodian of the Rewrite
preBattleDialog: This profile resets every five cycles.

start: I've watched you from the start. The Syndicate. Eli. Voit. I know everything.
midfight: I know your deck better than you. Not what you are now — what you were.
lowHP: The rewrite of your identity is halted. Temporarily.

act8_veritel.name: the Syndicate Creditor
preBattleDialog: I'll let Rozara go if you defeat me.

start: I promised a return. Not for you this time. For Rozara.
midfight: I've waited long. Prepared.
lowHP: You win — Rozara leaves. That's how the Syndicate works.

act9_pozorovatel.name: the Observer of the Transition
preBattleDialog: The deck says what you are. The conversation says what you want to say.

start: The conversation says what you want. The deck says what you are.
midfight: Every Courier thinks they're the exception.
lowHP: I hope that fourth outcome — will be you.

act10_sigma.name: Sigma — the Protocol
preBattleDialog: We'll check if the profile matches the intent.

start: PROFILE VERIFIED. INTENT CONFIRMED. WE'LL VERIFY PERFORMANCE.
midfight: Victory — you become the protocol. Consciously. Not a correction, an intent.
lowHP: Recording is not acceptance. One remains.

act10_pramati.name: First Mother
preBattleDialog: I sense the route on you.
Fight. Let me know what you are.

start: The system takes and returns rewritten. I take and return as the root.
midfight: Fight. Let me know what you are. Before I accept you.
lowHP: The root does not reject the weary. It accepts differently.

act10_paradox.name: Paradox of the Observer
preBattleDialog: I am you. Without the guide. Without forgiveness. Without hesitation.

start: I am you. Without the guide. Without forgiveness. Without hesitation.
midfight: Defeat me — remain yourself. Lose — we merge.
lowHP: The guide is optimistic. Nice.

act10_protokol_core.name: Rewrite Core
preBattleDialog: G u i d e  d e t e c t e d.
D e v i a t i o n  c o n f i r m e d.

start: GUIDE OUTSIDE PROTOCOL. ANOMALY. CORRECTING.
midfight: The protocol expects us to surrender. Therefore, we won't.
lowHP: DEVIATION... CANNOT... RECORD.

start: Beyond the gate of Convergence. Synth and Organic at once. Both are afraid.
midfight: You're not to guard it. You're to open it.
lowHP: The bridge is built more than once.
